notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content: [p]Roomballs just got a huge update! Tons of bugs have been fixed and Lobbies have been replaced by rooms. Now it's much easier and more flexible to create, join, and leave rooms, switch teams, start or cancel matches, and more. The distance filter has been removed, but the room list now shows info like FPS, distance, and host ping. The room creator can assign players to each team and make changes at any time. Spectator mode has also been added. You can now see how many players are online globally and in your country. Please download the update, try it out, and let us know what you think. Enjoy![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041409/dc01bc0a3cd2bc5ad646614b1cde1bb6f08552ec.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041409/0e8d2611f5062beae51a04e925d0c245380fcdb9.png"][/img][/p]
